Mizora combines automata performing domestic work, advanced chemical food production and an order described as free from poverty. This provides a real technological reduction of necessary labor within the admitted resident population. Guarantees are provisionally favorable for those residents, with a wide interval because universal prosperity is presented through a highly exclusionary vision. The novel’s eugenics, racial hierarchy and removal of men remain explicit boundaries, not erased by the word utopia.

Human women direct the technology, so control remains on the organic side. The central best guess allows some commonwealth agency without claiming equal ownership of productive assets; coercive state power remains a major qualification. The intermediate nonworking scenario permits leisure under domestic automata and chemical food production while counting science, care, art and useful chosen roles. The wide interval concerns admitted residents rather than excluded people or a fictional all-human census. Freedom from poverty therefore does not erase the novel’s eugenics, racial hierarchy and removal of men. Technological prosperity and severe membership boundaries are both retained rather than allowing a utopian label to settle every axis.

societies.description:
The commonwealth deliberately returns to handicraft after machines have become capable of performing almost all necessary work. Chapter XXVII says this directly: retained handwork is a preference rather than material necessity. This makes the society a particularly clear zero variant. Its reason is the pursuit of pleasurable, creative labor and equality, not an attempt to preserve conventional wage employment. Useful making remains part of ordinary life.

Common productive ownership and democratic direction support the strong distributed-control point. The low nonworking best guess counts chosen handicraft, farming, care and useful art despite the availability of machines that could replace much of it. Pleasurable work remains work, and freedom to refuse a role does not show that everyone does refuse. The wide interval allows dependents and sustained nonparticipants without deriving a census from a utopian ideal. Goods are shared rather than privately purchased through wages, so retained human effort coexists with strong material guarantees. This is deliberate creative restraint, not proof that the commonwealth has lost its productive technology.

Low comfort, participating-service limits and regional conditions qualify security without canceling the explicit basic-access mechanism for arrivals and stranded travelers.

Those activities still count as work when useful. The desert community is outside this point, and the other domes are not counted again merely because they have different names.

Replicator and transmutation technology supplies the productive context. Peer recognition matters strongly, but the economic passage explicitly distinguishes social and emotional frustration from material deprivation. Guarantees therefore receive a strong favorable estimate, with ordinary resource conditions and the limited excerpt preventing a perfect entitlement claim.

The control best guess favors shared human-derived agency because productive capabilities and equalizing institutions are broadly available, while final override powers remain uncertain. Advanced digital citizens are not automatically an unrelated AI ruling class. The intermediate nonworking scenario allows replicator-supported leisure while counting science, design, teaching, care and useful cultural roles. Peer recognition and emotional satisfaction are not counts of people working, and private recreation is not automatically a job. The wide interval concerns active persons in the first-edition model, excluding dormant files and multiplied bodies. Social frustration is kept separate from the strong stated provision of material basics.

The best guess is therefore about people participating in useful activity, rather than the amount of menial labor automated. Droid consent is compromised by the alternative of scrapping; their service is not evidence that all sentient beings have escaped labor.

It belongs here as an interpretive zero variant: technical labor-saving capacity exists, yet ordinary residents still live within an economy organized around employment, status and access. The weak guarantee score is a best guess from that inequality, not a claim that the films publish a complete welfare code. The city should not inherit Plazir-15’s explicitly depicted leisure system.

Control stays near concentrated organic authority because bureaucracies, political leaders and commercial owners direct the infrastructure. Droid autonomy does not make those owners irrelevant. The modest nonworking estimate allows dependents and excluded residents while assuming much of the adult population still contributes through paid work, informal services or care. It does not treat every background crowd as unemployed. This classification describes preserved labor alongside automation, without inventing a deliberate policy to protect jobs.

The record does not claim that their labor is technically useless, or that every Imperial industry could be replaced instantly at no cost.

societies.description:
Sentinel’s Iacon turns technical power into artificial deprivation. Some Cybertronians have their transformation cogs removed before activation and are forced into mining, while Energon is diverted to the Quintessons. The zero variant therefore has a direct institutional basis: rulers preserve a subordinated labor class rather than sharing the possibilities of their technology. Guarantees are strongly unfavorable for the population that must work under this manufactured hierarchy.

Control is autonomous synthetic authority relative to human ownership, but internally concentrated in Sentinel’s regime. Mechanical bodies do not erase the miners’ useful work or make them nonworking robots. Synthesis ends the war through a galaxy-wide organic–synthetic transformation, followed by Reaper repair work and shared knowledge. This record makes the requested best guess about its material implications: technical cooperation probably weakens the link between human labor and reconstruction, without proving an unlimited welfare state. Guarantees are rated moderately favorable because restoration and cooperation are depicted, with a broad interval for damaged worlds and unspecified access rules. Knowledge sharing is not itself a food entitlement.

Control is estimated as mixed cooperative agency. Humans do not own every Reaper, but the ending also does not establish a single machine dictator or an equal galactic cooperative constitution. The nonworking estimate allows continuing human science, repair, care and organization alongside exceptional synthetic assistance. Transformation does not make useful activity cease. These coordinates describe one selected ending and its projected near future, rather than a canonical outcome common to every playthrough or an exact census of all species.

guarantees.basis: Reconstruction and shared capabilities suggest a floor; individual entitlements and local shortages remain inferred.

control.basis: Cooperation among autonomous transformed agents supports mixed authority with unusually broad uncertainty.

nonworking.basis: Human-only participation best guess allows large machine assistance and substantial chosen or necessary recovery work.

societies.description:
The manga explicitly connects an unmanned factory with an employer’s dismissal of labor-union demands. That makes its technological inequality a stronger comparison than cyberbrains alone. This is retained as an interpretive zero variant: automation can remove production jobs while access and bargaining power remain unequal. The weak guarantee score is an editorial reading of that relationship, not a claim that the manga supplies a comprehensive national welfare code. Human careers and informal work remain important.

Companies and state institutions hold concentrated productive power; networked minds do not automatically create either a commons or an autonomous AI government. The modest nonworking estimate allows displacement and dependents while counting embodied cyborg activity, care and technical service as real human-derived work. It does not classify a worker as a machine merely because the body is artificial. The scope is deliberately the original manga, since the scholarly excerpt distinguishes its overt labor dialogue from the film’s different emphasis.

The Edo present a peaceful, pleasure-oriented society with comfortable everyday surroundings and severe rules hidden beneath that ease. The best-guess post-work reading is that advanced support reduces much necessary subsistence labor, while the precise production mechanism is left uncertain. This is explicitly an inferred admission: leisure and peace alone do not demonstrate robot-made goods. Tigerishka describes a wider civilization with democratic but restrictive elders, while the world’s dissident aims distinguish its local population. The guarantee best guess allows a substantial internal floor, qualified by uncertain resident coverage. A guest’s comfort is not proof that every ordinary person has equal unconditional necessities.

 Resident and institutional agency receives positive control weight, with elder restrictions and possible machine dependence inside a broad interval. An artificial planet does not automatically have an AI sovereign. The moderate nonworking scenario permits extensive routine substitution while counting engineering, administration, care, services and useful creation. Planetary scale and extraordinary mobility are not labor statistics. Active biological residents form the alien-person proxy; temporary human guests and absent wider populations are not added. This partial-transition interpretation preserves the actual technological habitat without importing a uniform galactic constitution from a short account.

The record is a partial technical-provision model with a severely qualified floor, not a claim that childhood or a short life equals leisure. Broad bounds preserve ordinary allocation uncertainty and keep the film’s thirty-year rule and television’s human rulers in their separate records.
